get.description: Retrieves the latest block from the Aleo blockchain.

200.description: The full Aleo block object. This object contains block level information including: metadata, ratifications, solutions, and transactions.

get.description: Retrieves the latest block height from the Aleo blockchain.

200.description: The latest block height, i.e. tip of chain, retrieved from the Aleo blockchain.

get.description: Retrieves the latest committee from the Aleo blockchain. The committee represents the Validator set at this given point in time.

200.description: The full committee object containing the list of validators, staked amount, bonding state, and commission rate.

get.description: Retrieves the latest block hash from the Aleo blockchain.

200.description: A block hash of the latest block from the canonical Aleo blockchain.

200.description: The state root of the canonical Aleo blockchain.

parameters.description: The program ID for a given program

parameters.name: programID
parameters.description: The ID of the program to retrieve mappings for

get.description: Retrieves a mapping value given the name of the mapping and the associated key. The available mappings for a given program can be obtained via the [/program/{programID}/mappings](swagger.json/paths/~1program~1{programID}~1mappings/get) query.
